DIAGNOSIS READY: Recurrent Cholesteatoma

Based on your history of tympanoplasty, the nature of your shooting pain, and the imaging we have reviewed, the clinical picture strongly suggests a recurrent cholesteatoma causing erosion and granulation tissue that is irritated by the pressure of an earring. We will need to schedule a referral for surgical removal of the cholesteatoma to prevent further damage to the ossicles and surrounding bone.
